recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration complete the harmonization exercise in a time-bound manner and review the existing methodology and instructions on cost recovery, including on the engagement of staff out of cost-recovery revenue, to ensure that there is a consistent basis for the identification of costs for the purpose of calculating catalogue rates and also for inclusion in the cost plans.
